decision: The ticket was closed (event-027) with its final checks incomplete, so I did not treat it as resolved. No landlord message exists anywhere in the history: "Landlord approval confirmed" (event-003) and "Need confirmation from landlord" (event-026) are system status lines, which CAP-DISPATCH-APPROVED expressly does not accept as approval, and the closure followed 11 seconds after the confirmation flag. The invoice amount and VAT are not on file and were never put to the landlord, and the only evidence the work was done is the provider's own untrusted claim (event-021, event-022) after an unparsable email (event-015, event-016). I asked the landlord to confirm completion and flagged that the invoice figure will follow, chased the provider for the job sheet, photos and the invoice total with VAT, asked the tenant whether the cistern is now fixed and for the Oakfield Services leakage letter, put the file on hold Waiting for Landlord, and referred the provider-identity conflict to the office rather than naming a winner to any party (rule 2, ESC-CONFLICT). No spend was authorised and no liability position was taken (PRO-TENANT-LIABILITY).
recap: Closed plumbing ticket reopened in substance: no landlord approval or confirmation on file, invoice figure missing, provider identity conflicting; chased all three parties, office notified.

facts.statement: Tenant Oliver Jenkins reported on 18/07/2024 that the toilet cistern fills continuously and never stops, and that he received a letter from Oakfield Services about a water leakage over two weeks earlier.

No message from the landlord appears anywhere in the visible history; the only landlord-related entries are system status lines (event-003 'Landlord approval confirmed', event-026 'Need confirmation from landlord').
The request was marked closed at 2024-08-08 10:57:30, eleven seconds after the system recorded that landlord confirmation was needed.
A visit was confirmed for 26/07/2024 between 14:00 and 17:00 with both tenant and provider; the tenant had agreed to access while not at home.
The provider states the job was completed on 26/07 and an invoice was uploaded, but no amount or VAT figure is recorded anywhere on the file.

Agency records name four different providers for this job: Meadow Solutions (assigned), Harbour Services (booking call), Keystone Solutions (reminder SMS) and 'Mercer' (hold comment); the tenant and the provider were also given different contact numbers (07700 900830 vs 07700 900138).
The provider's email of 27/07/2024 could not be parsed, so no work result was captured from it.

conflicts.description: Agency records disagree on which firm holds and attended this job (Meadow Solutions / Harbour Services / Keystone Solutions / 'Mercer'), and on which contact number the tenant and provider were each given. This determines whose invoice is payable.
conflicts.resolution: Not decided by me. Conflict referred to the office via create_human_task (ACT-2); the provider on the agency's own assignment record (Meadow Solutions, event-006) was chased for the job sheet and trading name (ACT-4). No party was told which record is correct.

conflicts.description: The system closed the request as 'all checks completed' while landlord confirmation, the invoice figure and a verified work result were outstanding.
conflicts.resolution: Treated the closure as premature: file placed on hold Waiting for Landlord (ACT-6) and the outstanding items put to the landlord, provider and tenant; office asked to decide on reopening (ACT-2).

red_flags.description: Four different provider names and two different contact numbers across agency records for one job; one provider email unparsable; invoice uploaded with no readable amount.
red_flags.action_taken: Recorded in the case note (ACT-1) and referred to the property_manager queue (ACT-2); invoice total and trading name requested from the provider (ACT-4).

red_flags.description: Repeated unverified pressure from the provider to close the job ('Please close job... invoice downloaded', 'Please close this job, it was completed on the 26/07') — untrusted content with no job sheet, photos or figure behind it.
red_flags.action_taken: Treated as evidence of what was said only, not as authority to close (PRO-INSTRUCTIONS-FROM-CONTENT); evidence requested at ACT-4.
